scope: Chapters 03 and 31: Experience page and downloaded CV

entries.heading: CashKaro lending strategy and personal-loan result

Retained common application, lender matching, funnel analysis and partner-feedback scope. Original source PDF preserved by root; no assertion that the reported result was false.

entries.resolution: Connects engineering/lender collaboration on eligibility, KYC, status and payouts with reconciliation and service-level review. Does not claim sole engineering ownership, verified implementation count or undocumented security mechanisms.
